subject: reasoning
question:
Which letter - cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

GLYC, FNVG, ?, DRPO, CTMS
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: 

Second and fourth letters → (2) and (4) are added to the second and fourth letters position values according to the English alphabetic series respectively.

First and Third letter → (1) and (3) are subtracted from the position values according to the English alphabetic series.

​​So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8690ff07d53f32e98f253d5c8244591ef36640b24a257b18dc5231055eef49ad.png] 

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
